notes: Cross-border public transport to Portugal and France is missing from TravelTime's data (Nov 2026 check). Airports across the border are reached through border stations instead (Vigo, Huelva, Sevilla, Figueres-Vilafant, Irun): the time to the station plus the scheduled bus or train ride and 10 min to change. Those times are estimates (hatched). Gibraltar works on foot.
Where an airport bus is missing from the data, times are mostly walking (e.g. Maó).

No public transport link in TravelTime's data, so never the nearest: Lisbon (LIS), Toulouse-Blagnac (TLS), Castellón (CDT), Región de Murcia (RMU), Tarbes-Lourdes-Pyrénées (LDE), Lleida-Alguaire (ILD), El Hierro (VDE), La Gomera (GMZ), Melilla (MLN), Pau-Pyrénées (PUF), Salamanca (SLM).
